summary: CCC-built fire lookout on Bighorn NF's Black Mountain, finished 1939-40, in fire detection until 1980, closed to the public since 2024 for building repairs.

facts.design: L-4 cab, about 14 by 14 feet, with catwalk on a stone foundation
facts.status_note: Standing, but the building has been closed to the public since 2024; a special order runs through December 31, 2028 unless rescinded

staffing.status: no longer used for fire detection; early fire detection program ended 1980

access.note: Building closed since 2024 for public safety. Special order published June 23, 2025 runs through Dec. 31, 2028 or until rescinded. Trail status after the order is not stated in the sources read.

visit.trail_note: Trailhead reached from Dayton via Hwy 14 and FSR 16, then FSR 222. Trail #011 is motorized for vehicles 50 inches or less in width; the last 300 yards or so is hiking only. No facilities at the trailhead or the lookout. Trailhead page last updated May 13, 2025, before the closure order.

corrections.why: Building closed to the public since 2024 for public safety; a special order published June 23, 2025 keeps it closed through Dec. 31, 2028 or until rescinded.

corrections.proposed: 2014 restoration effort begun; completion not confirmed
corrections.why: The 2014 chapter report describes a restoration effort, not a finished restoration, and the 2025 news report says the closure lasts until building repairs are complete. The 2014 report also names Historic Core, not HistoriCorps.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR and the 2025 news report say 1939; firelookout.com says 1939/1940; the CCC camp record of July 27, 1940 shows interior carpentry done and an entry ramp still being built, with completion by October 15, 1940, not inspected. The story reports both.
NHLR gives 9,383 ft (2,860 m), which matches the record's elevation_m; firelookout.com gives 9492'. The NHLR figure is kept; elevation is not stored in facts.

notes_for_editor: Closure and access are well supported by the 2025 news report, which is a Wyoming News Exchange piece; the Forest Service order itself was not read. Build year is disputed (1939 vs. completion October 1940). Elevation differs between NHLR (9,383 ft) and firelookout.com (9492'). The 2014 report says Historic Core; the 2025 article says HistoriCorps; the story treats them as the same group but that is not confirmed. Not read: Living New Deal (403 error), a Sheridan Press closure article and a 2024 Cowboy State Daily piece (search snippets only). No last-watch date found; the 1980 end date comes from the 2025 article. No photos added; NHLR photo credits not checked.
